filing_excerpt: Buyer Holdings Corp. will acquire Acme Target, Inc. for $50.00 per share in cash. Outside Date: June 15, 2027. Termination fee: $150 million. Subject to shareholder and Hart-Scott-Rodino approvals. No CVR. No stock exchange ratio.

MegaBank Corp. agrees to acquire Regional Trust Co. in an all-stock merger at an exchange ratio of 0.8500 MegaBank shares per Regional share. Outside Date December 31, 2026. Termination fee $85 million. No cash. No CVR. Requires Federal Reserve and shareholder approval.

North Pharmaceuticals will acquire BioSpark Inc. for $22.50 in cash plus 0.125 North shares per BioSpark share (mixed). Outside Date: March 31, 2027. Termination fee $40 million. Includes a CVR of up to $3.00 per share. Antitrust and shareholder approvals required.

Atlas Energy Partners to purchase Canyon Midstream LLC for $18.00 cash per unit. End Date / Outside Date: September 1, 2027. Break-up fee $25 million. No exchange ratio. No CVR. FERC and unitholder approvals.

Pacific Semiconductor will acquire ChipFoundry Ltd in a stock-for-stock deal at 1.200 Pacific shares per ChipFoundry share. Outside Date August 15, 2027. Termination fee $220 million. No cash consideration. No CVR. CFIUS and shareholder approvals.

Horizon Media Group agrees to buy StreamCast Inc. for $35.00 per share in cash. Outside Date: January 15, 2027. Termination fee equals $95 million. CVR of $2.00 tied to subscriber milestones. FCC and shareholder approvals required.

Union Retail Corp. will acquire CornerShop Holdings for $12.00 cash plus 0.40 Union shares per CornerShop share. Outside Date May 30, 2027. Termination fee $55 million. No CVR. HSR and shareholder approvals.

Silverline Insurance to merge with Mutual Shield Co. in an all-stock transaction at an exchange ratio of 0.500 Silverline shares. Outside Date: November 1, 2026. Termination fee $30 million. No cash. No CVR. State insurance commissioner and shareholder approvals.
Delta Logistics Inc. will acquire PortBridge Corp. for $67.25 per share in cash. Outside Date July 31, 2027. Termination fee $175 million. No stock. No CVR. DOT and shareholder approvals required.

Evergreen Capital Partners to purchase GreenField REIT for $28.00 cash plus a CVR of up to $1.50. Outside Date: April 15, 2027. Termination fee $48 million. No exchange ratio. REIT shareholder and FINRA-related approvals.
